title: Statin use and breast cancer survival
text: Statins, an established drug group for cholesterol, may reduce breast cancer recurrence and mortality.

title: Statin therapy after diagnosis of breast cancer
text: Cohort study of simvastatin use following breast cancer diagnosis and survival.

title: Alkylphenols in human milk
text: Concentrations of nonylphenol and octylphenol in breast milk were related to dietary habits.

title: Mercury exposure and epilepsy
text: Methylmercury is a potential environmental risk factor contributing to epileptogenesis and seizure disorder.

title: Phosphate is a vascular toxin
text: Elevated serum phosphate levels in kidney failure promote vascular calcification and cardiovascular risk.

title: Dietary fiber and colorectal cancer
text: High intake of dietary fiber from whole grains lowers the risk of colorectal cancer.

text: Adherence to a Mediterranean diet reduced the incidence of myocardial infarction and cardiovascular events.

title: Olive oil polyphenols and heart disease
text: Olive oil polyphenols improve the cholesterol profile and endothelial function.

title: Vitamin D supplementation and bone health
text: Vitamin D supplements increase bone density and reduce fracture risk in older adults.

title: Sugar sweetened beverages and obesity
text: Consumption of sugar sweetened beverages is associated with weight gain and obesity in children.

title: Green tea catechins and cancer prevention
text: Catechins in green tea showed antiproliferative effects in cancer cell lines.

title: Red meat intake and colorectal cancer
text: Processed red meat consumption increases colorectal cancer risk.

title: Salt intake and hypertension
text: Reducing sodium intake lowers blood pressure in hypertensive adults.

title: Omega-3 fatty acids and depression
text: Fish oil omega-3 supplementation may improve depressive symptoms.
